		{

			yield break;
		}
		if (AutoTestRunner.OwnedReportMode)
		{

			while (VSLegacyUnlockGrant.Pending && Time.realtimeSinceStartup < grantDeadline)

	// Token: 0x06001035 RID: 4149 RVA: 0x00046904 File Offset: 0x00044B04
	private static bool IsPhotonReadyForRoomCreation()
	{
		return PhotonNetwork.IsConnectedAndReady && PhotonNetwork.InLobby && PhotonNetwork.NetworkClientState == ClientState.JoinedLobby;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001036 RID: 4150 RVA: 0x0004691E File Offset: 0x00044B1E
	private IEnumerator WaitForPhotonReady()
	{
		this.Log("Waiting for Photon connection...");
		float elapsed = 0f;
		float stableTime = 0f;
		bool connectRequested = false;
		bool lobbyJoinRequested = false;
		while (elapsed < 60f)
		{
			if (!PhotonNetwork.IsConnected)
			{
				stableTime = 0f;
				lobbyJoinRequested = false;
				if (!connectRequested && (PhotonNetwork.NetworkClientState == ClientState.Disconnected || PhotonNetwork.NetworkClientState == ClientState.PeerCreated))
				{
					this.Log("Photon not connected, connecting manually...");
					PhotonNetwork.ConnectUsingSettings();
					connectRequested = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				connectRequested = false;
				if (AutoTestRunner.IsPhotonReadyForRoomCreation())
				{
					stableTime += 0.5f;
					if (stableTime >= 1.5f)
					{
						this.Log(string.Format("Photon ready! State: {0}, InLobby: {1}", PhotonNetwork.NetworkClientState, PhotonNetwork.InLobby));
						yield break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stableTime = 0f;
					if (!PhotonNetwork.InLobby && PhotonNetwork.NetworkClientState == ClientState.ConnectedToMasterServer)
					{
						if (!lobbyJoinRequested)
						{
							this.Log("Joining lobby...");
							PhotonNetwork.JoinLobby();
							lobbyJoinRequested = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						lobbyJoinRequested = false;
					}
				}
			}
			elapsed += 0.5f;
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		}
		yield break;
	}

		yield return new WaitForSeconds(3f);

		Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
		foreach (string tab in new string[]
		{
			"AUDIO",
			"VIDEO",
			"CONTROLS"
		})
		{
			GameObject gameObject = GameObject.Find("Tab_" + tab);
			if (gameObject != null)
			{
				Button component = gameObject.GetComponent<Button>();
				if (component != null)
				{
					component.onClick.Invoke();
					yield return new WaitForSeconds(2f);

			{
				this.Log("QA_SETTINGS:tab " + tab + " not found");

			this.AuditInvisibleText(null);
			shot = null;
			tab = null;
		}
		string[] array = null;
		this.Log("Settings smoke: done");
		Application.Quit(0);
		yield break;
	}

	private static float VerticalGap(Rect a, Rect b)

	private static float EffectiveAlpha(TMP_Text label)
	{

		while (transform != null)
		{
			CanvasGroup component = transform.GetComponent<CanvasGroup>();
			if (component != null)
			{
				num *= component.alpha;
				if (component.ignoreParentGroups)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			transform = transform.parent;

	}

	private static float FractionChanged(Texture2D a, Texture2D b)
	{

		{
			return 1f;
		}
		Color32[] pixels = a.GetPixels32();
		Color32[] pixels2 = b.GetPixels32();

		for (int i = 0; i < pixels.Length; i += 7)
		{
			if (Mathf.Abs((int)(pixels[i].r - pixels2[i].r)) + Mathf.Abs((int)(pixels[i].g - pixels2[i].g)) + Mathf.Abs((int)(pixels[i].b - pixels2[i].b)) > 12)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		return (float)num / ((float)pixels.Length / 7f);
	}

	private IEnumerator SignInRealAccount(bl_LoginPro loginPro)
	{
		string[] array = AutoTestRunner.AccountLogin.Split(':', StringSplitOptions.None);
		if (array.Length < 2)
		{
			this.Log("ERROR: -account expects user:pass");
			yield break;
		}
		string user = array[0];
		string pass = array[1];
		float ipDeadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartup + 30f;
		while (Time.realtimeSinceStartup < ipDeadline && string.IsNullOrEmpty(bl_DataBase.Instance.SessionIP))
		{
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		}
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(bl_DataBase.Instance.SessionIP))
		{
			this.Log("ERROR: backend handshake never returned a session IP");
			yield break;
		}
		this.Log("QA_ACCOUNT:handshake session_ip_present=true");
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AutoTestRunner.AccountRegister))
		{
			string[] array2 = AutoTestRunner.AccountRegister.Split(':', StringSplitOptions.None);
			if (array2.Length < 2)
			{
				this.Log("ERROR: -register-account expects nick:email");
				yield break;
			}
			this.Log(string.Concat(new string[]
			{
				"Registering account '",
				user,
				"' (nick ",
				array2[0],
				")"
			}));
			loginPro.SinUp(user, array2[0], pass, array2[1]);
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(8f);
		}
		if (bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged)
		{
			this.Log(string.Format("QA_ACCOUNT:existing_session id={0} nick={1}", bl_DataBase.LocalLoggedUser.ID, bl_DataBase.LocalLoggedUser.NickName));
		}
		this.Log("Signing in as '" + user + "'");
		loginPro.Login(user, pass);
		float deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartup + 45f;
		while (Time.realtimeSinceStartup < deadline && !AutoTestRunner.IsSignedInAs(user))
		{
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		}
		if (AutoTestRunner.IsSignedInAs(user))
		{
			LoginUserInfo localLoggedUser = bl_DataBase.LocalLoggedUser;
			this.Log(string.Format("QA_ACCOUNT:signed_in id={0} nick={1}", localLoggedUser.ID, localLoggedUser.NickName));
		}
		else
		{
			this.Log("QA_ACCOUNT:sign_in_failed after 45s");
		}
		yield break;
	}

	private void SampleFrameTime()

		{

		}
		float unscaledDeltaTime = Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
		this.frameTimes.Add(unscaledDeltaTime);
		if (unscaledDeltaTime > this.worstFrameSeconds)
		{
			this.worstFrameSeconds = unscaledDeltaTime;
			this.worstFrameAt = this.testTimer;
		}
		if (unscaledDeltaTime > 0.25f)
		{
			this.Log(string.Format("Perf: long frame {0:F0}ms at t={1:F1}s", unscaledDeltaTime * 1000f, this.testTimer));
		}
		if (!this.renderStateReported && this.testTimer > 8f)
		{
			this.ReportRenderState();
		}
	}

	private bool IsSpawnOccupied(Vector3 position)
	{

		if (bl_PlayerReferences != null && !bl_PlayerReferences.IsDeath() && Vector3.Distance(position, bl_PlayerReferences.transform.position) < 1.5f)
		{
			return true;
		}
		List<MFPSPlayer> list = (bl_GameManager.Instance != null) ? bl_GameManager.Instance.OthersActorsInScene : null;
		if (list == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			MFPSPlayer mfpsplayer = list[i];

			{

			}
		}

	}

	private bool VerifyTeamAffiliation(bl_AIShooter agent, Team team)

		{
			if (!(this.SpawningBots[j] == null) && !(this.SpawningBots[j].gameObject == null))

			}
		}

	public void ReplaceBotWithPlayer(Player newPlayer, Team playerTeam)

		{
			return;

		string remplaceBot = string.Empty;

		if (num != -1)

			this.DeleteBot(remplaceBot);

			list[num].Bot = string.Empty;
			if (bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient)
			{
				int num2 = (playerTeam == Team.Team2) ? 2 : 1;
				base.photonView.RPC("SyncBotStat", RpcTarget.Others, new object[]
				{
					string.Format("{0}|{1}", num2, newPlayer.NickName),
					num,
					4
				});
			}
			Debug.Log(string.Concat(new string[]
			{
				"<color=yellow>Bot ",
				remplaceBot,
				" was replaced by ",
				newPlayer.NickName,
				"</color>"
			}));
		}
		if (newPlayer.IsMasterClient && bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient && !this.isMasterAlredyInTeam && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(remplaceBot))
		{
			bl_AIShooter bl_AIShooter = this.AllBots.Find((bl_AIShooter x) => x.AIName == remplaceBot);
			if (bl_AIShooter != null)
			{
				Component component = bl_AIShooter.GetComponent<PhotonView>();
				bl_AIShooter.References.shooterHealth.DestroyEntity();
				this.AllBots.Remove(bl_AIShooter);
				this.AllBotsTransforms.Remove(bl_AIShooter.AimTarget);
				PhotonNetwork.Destroy(component.gameObject);
			}
			this.isMasterAlredyInTeam = true;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060011B3 RID: 4531 RVA: 0x00054B08 File Offset: 0x00052D08
	public bool TryClaim(int index, out string message)
	{
		message = string.Empty;
		if (index < 0 || index >= 60)
		{
			message = "INVALID REWARD.";
			return false;
		}
		if (!bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged)
		{
			message = "LOGIN REQUIRED TO CLAIM BATTLEPASS REWARDS.";
			return false;
		}
		this.RefreshUserKey(false);
		this.LoadState();
		if (bl_BattlePassProgress.IsSeasonEnded())
		{
			message = "SEASON ENDED.";
			return false;
		}
		bl_BattlePassProgress.Reward reward = bl_BattlePassProgress.Rewards[index];
		if (this.xp < reward.RequiredXp)
		{
			message = string.Format("NEED {0} XP.", reward.RequiredXp - this.xp);
			return false;
		}
		if (this.IsClaimed(index))
		{
			message = "ALREADY CLAIMED.";
			return false;
		}
		if (reward.Type != bl_BattlePassProgress.RewardType.WeaponUnlock)
		{
			this.claimedMask |= 1UL << index;
			this.SaveState();
			this.ClaimOnServer(index, delegate(bool granted, string serverMessage)
			{
				if (!granted)
				{
					this.claimedMask &= ~(1UL << index);
					this.SaveState();
				}
				bl_LobbyUI.ShowOverAllMessage(serverMessage);
				Action onChanged2 = bl_BattlePassProgress.OnChanged;
				if (onChanged2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				onChanged2();
			});
			message = "CLAIMING " + reward.Label + "...";
			return true;
		}
		if (bl_DataBase.Instance != null && bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged)
		{
			this.claimedMask |= 1UL << index;
			this.SaveState();
			int captured = index;
			this.ClaimWeaponOnServer(index, delegate(bool granted, string note)
			{
				if (!granted)
				{
					this.claimedMask &= ~(1UL << captured);
					this.SaveState();
				}
				bl_LobbyUI.ShowOverAllMessage(note);
			});
			message = "CLAIMING…";
			return true;
		}
		int weaponId;
		bl_GunInfo weaponInfo;
		if (!this.TryResolveWeaponReward(index, out weaponId, out weaponInfo))
		{
			this.GrantCoinsFallback(out message);
		}
		else if (!this.GrantWeaponUnlock(weaponId, weaponInfo, out message))
		{
			return false;
		}
		this.claimedMask |= 1UL << index;
		this.SaveState();
		Action onChanged = bl_BattlePassProgress.OnChanged;
		if (onChanged != null)
		{
			onChanged();
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static int[] ReadUnlocks(string json)
	{

		if (num < 0)
		{

		}

		}

		List<int> list = new List<int>(array.Length);
		string[] array2 = array;
		for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
		{
			int item;
			if (int.TryParse(array2[i].Trim(), out item))
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
		}
		return list.ToArray();

	private static string ReadJsonString(string json, string field)

		{
			return null;
		}
		int num = json.IndexOf("\"" + field + "\":\"", StringComparison.Ordinal);

		num += field.Length + 4;
		int num2 = json.IndexOf('"', num);

	public void StopAndSaveTime()
	{
		if (!bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged || this.StartPlayTime <= 1f)
		{
			return;
		}
		float num = Time.time - this.StartPlayTime;
		int minutes = Mathf.CeilToInt(num / 60f);
		if (minutes <= 1)
		{
			return;
		}
		WWWForm wwwform = base.CreateForm(FormHashParm.Name, true);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("id", this.LocalUser.ID);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("values", minutes);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("typ", 3);
		base.WebRequest.POST(base.GetURL(bl_LoginProDataBase.URLType.DataBase), wwwform, delegate(ULoginResult result)
		{
			if (result.isError)
			{
				result.PrintError();
				return;
			}
			if (this.ULoginSettings.FullLogs)
			{
				result.Print(false);
			}
			if (result.resultState == ULoginResult.Status.Success)
			{
				this.LocalUser.PlayTime += minutes;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMinutes((double)this.LocalUser.PlayTime);
				string str = string.Format("{0:D2}h:{1:D2}m", timeSpan.Hours, timeSpan.Minutes);
				Debug.Log("Save Time: " + minutes.ToString() + " Total Play Time: " + str);
				this.FireUpdateData();
			}
		}, null);
	}

						damageData.From = this.creator.Name;
						damageData.isHeadShot = false;
						damageData.Cause = ((!this.creator.isRealPlayer) ? DamageCause.Bot : DamageCause.Explosion);
						damageData.GunID = this.cachedData.WeaponID;
						damageData.Actor = bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer;
						if (componentInParent != null)

		List<string> list = new List<string>();
		foreach (Collider collider in array)
		{
			if (!collider.isLocalPlayerCollider() && !collider.CompareTag("Untagged"))
			{
				IMFPSDamageable component = collider.transform.GetComponent<IMFPSDamageable>();

					{
						if (list.Contains(collider.transform.root.name) || (!this.ExplosionCanHitTarget(collider.transform.root, new Vector3(0f, 0.6f, 0f), true) && !this.ExplosionCanHitTarget(collider.transform.root, new Vector3(0f, 0.15f, 0f), true)))

						MFPSActor = this.creator,
						ActorViewID = this.creator.ActorViewID,
						GunID = this.cachedData.WeaponID,
						From = this.creator.Name
					};
					damageData.Cause = ((!this.creator.isRealPlayer) ? DamageCause.Bot : DamageCause.Explosion);
					if (damageData.MFPSActor == null)
					{
						Debug.Log(string.Format("Explosion actor '{0}' was not found in the scene, maybe left the match?", this.creator.ActorViewID));

	// Token: 0x06000AFF RID: 2815 RVA: 0x0002FF94 File Offset: 0x0002E194
	private void CheckPlayersInMatch()
	{
		if (bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.IsInitialized || this.GameMatchState != MatchState.Waiting)
		{
			bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText("", false);
			return;
		}
		bool flag = false;
		if (base.isOneTeamMode)
		{
			flag = (PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length >= this.WaitingPlayersAmount);
		}
		else
		{
			int num = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.GetPlayersInTeam(Team.Team1).Length;
			int num2 = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.GetPlayersInTeam(Team.Team2).Length;
			int num3 = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length;
			if (bl_AIMananger.Instance.BotsActive)
			{
				num3 += bl_AIMananger.Instance.BotsStatistics.Count;
				num += bl_AIMananger.Instance.GetAllBotsInTeam(Team.Team1).Count;
				num2 += bl_AIMananger.Instance.GetAllBotsInTeam(Team.Team2).Count;
			}
			if (num3 >= this.WaitingPlayersAmount)
			{
				if ((num <= 0 || num2 <= 0) && this.WaitingPlayersAmount > 1)
				{
					bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText(bl_GameTexts.WaitingTeamBalance, true);
					return;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			if (bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient)
			{
				bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.InitAfterWaiting();
			}
			this.SetGameState(MatchState.Starting);
			bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.SetTimeState(RoomTimeState.Started, true);
			Action action = this.onAllPlayersRequiredIn;
			if (action != null)
			{
				action();
			}
			bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText("", false);
			return;
		}
		bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText(string.Format(bl_GameTexts.WaitingPlayers, PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length, 2), true);
	}

	private void ApplyGrenadeOnlyLoadout()
	{
		bl_PlayerReferences localPlayerReferences = bl_MFPS.LocalPlayerReferences;
		if (localPlayerReferences == null || localPlayerReferences.gunManager == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		bl_GunManager gunManager = localPlayerReferences.gunManager;
		int num = this.GetGrenadeWeaponId();
		if (num < 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		bl_Gun gunOnListById = gunManager.GetGunOnListById(num);
		if (gunOnListById == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (gunManager.PlayerEquip == null)
		{
			gunManager.PlayerEquip = new List<bl_Gun>();
		}
		while (gunManager.PlayerEquip.Count <= 2)
		{
			gunManager.PlayerEquip.Add(null);
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < gunManager.PlayerEquip.Count; i++)
		{
			if (i != 2)
			{
				if (gunManager.PlayerEquip[i] != null)
				{
					gunManager.PlayerEquip[i].gameObject.SetActive(false);
				}
				gunManager.PlayerEquip[i] = null;
			}
		}
		foreach (bl_Gun bl_Gun in gunManager.AllGuns)
		{
			if (!(bl_Gun == null) && bl_Gun != gunOnListById)
			{
				bl_Gun.gameObject.SetActive(false);
			}
		}
		gunManager.PlayerEquip[2] = gunOnListById;
		gunManager.currentWeaponIndex = 2;
		gunManager.CurrentGun = gunOnListById;
		gunManager.CanSwich = true;
		gunOnListById.gameObject.SetActive(true);
		gunOnListById.SetInifinityAmmo(true);
		bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
		if (instance != null)
		{
			instance.SetLoadout(gunManager.PlayerEquip);
		}
		bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance2 = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
		if (instance2 != null)
		{
			instance2.SetEquippedSlot(2);
		}
		bl_EventHandler.ChangeWeaponEvent(gunOnListById.GunID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000714 RID: 1812 RVA: 0x00022B50 File Offset: 0x00020D50
	private int GetGrenadeWeaponId()
	{
		if (this.grenadeWeaponId >= 0)
		{
			return this.grenadeWeaponId;
		}
		List<bl_GunInfo> allWeapons = bl_GameData.Instance.AllWeapons;
		for (int i = 0; i < allWeapons.Count; i++)
		{
			if (allWeapons[i] != null && allWeapons[i].Type == GunType.Grenade && allWeapons[i].Name == "Grenade")
			{
				this.grenadeWeaponId = i;
				return this.grenadeWeaponId;
			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < allWeapons.Count; j++)
		{
			if (allWeapons[j] != null && allWeapons[j].Type == GunType.Grenade)
			{
				this.grenadeWeaponId = j;
				return this.grenadeWeaponId;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	public bool OnPickUpAmmo(int bullets, int projectiles, int gunID)
	{
		if (gunID != -1 && gunID != this.GunID)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (this.WeaponType == GunType.Knife)
		{
			return false;
		}

		{

			{
				return false;

			{

			}
		}
		else if (this.WeaponType == GunType.Grenade)
		{
			this.m_remainingClips += projectiles;
			new MFPSLocalNotification(string.Format("+{0} {1}", projectiles.ToString(), base.Info.Name));
		}
		else
		{
			if (this.m_remainingClips >= this.BulletsPerMagazine * this.maxNumberOfClips)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int remainingClips = this.m_remainingClips;
			this.m_remainingClips += bullets;
			this.m_remainingClips = Mathf.Clamp(this.m_remainingClips, 0, this.BulletsPerMagazine * this.maxNumberOfClips);
			new MFPSLocalNotification(string.Format("+{0} {1} Bullets", this.m_remainingClips - remainingClips, base.Info.Name));
		}
		this.UpdateUI();
		return true;
	}

	public void PickUpGun(GunPickUpData e)
	{

		{

		{

				{
					this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, i);
					if (this.EquipPickUpMode.IsEnumFlagPresent(bl_GunManager.AutoChangeOnPickup.OnlyOnEmptySlots))
					{
						base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(null, bl_Gun, null, i));
						this.currentWeaponIndex = i;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			bool flag = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex] == null;
			if (!flag)
			{
				int gunID = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].GunID;
			}
			int[] array = new int[2];
			int num = flag ? 3 : this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].RemainingClips;
			array[0] = num;
			array[1] = (flag ? 30 : this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].bulletsLeft);
			bl_Gun bl_Gun2;
			if (!bl_GameData.Instance.weaponSlotRuler.CanBeOnSlot(weapon.Type, this.currentWeaponIndex))
			{
				int j = 0;
				while (j < 4)
				{
					if (bl_GameData.Instance.weaponSlotRuler.CanBeOnSlot(weapon.Type, j))
					{
						bl_Gun2 = this.PlayerEquip[j];
						this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, j);
						if (this.EquipPickUpMode == bl_GunManager.AutoChangeOnPickup.OnlyOnReplacements)
						{
							base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun2, bl_Gun, array, j));
							this.currentWeaponIndex = j;
							return;
						}
						bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.Instance.ThrowGun(new bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.ThrowData
						{
							GunID = bl_Gun2.GunID,
							Origin = this.GetThrowPosition(),
							Direction = this.GetThrowDirection(),
							Data = array,
							AutoDestroy = false
						});
						return;
					}
					else
					{
						j++;
					}
				}
			}
			bl_Gun2 = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex];
			this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, this.currentWeaponIndex);
			base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun2, bl_Gun, array, this.currentWeaponIndex));
			return;
		}
		foreach (bl_Gun bl_Gun3 in this.PlayerEquip)
		{
			if (bl_Gun3 != null && bl_Gun3.GunID == e.ID)
			{
				bl_Gun3.OnPickUpAmmo(e.Bullets * e.Clips, 1, e.ID);

			}
		}

	// Token: 0x06000F37 RID: 3895 RVA: 0x000415B8 File Offset: 0x0003F7B8
	private void SetUpPickUpWeapon(GunPickUpData data, bl_Gun gun, int slotID)
	{
		this.PlayerEquip[slotID] = gun;
		gun.Setup(true);
		if (gun.Info.Type == GunType.Grenade)
		{
			if (gun.bulletsLeft <= 0)
			{
				gun.bulletsLeft = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				int remainingClips = gun.RemainingClips;
				gun.RemainingClips = remainingClips + 1;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			gun.bulletsLeft = data.Bullets;
			gun.RemainingClips = data.Clips;
		}
		bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
		if (instance == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		instance.ReplaceSlot(slotID, gun);
	}

	public IEnumerator SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun currentGun, bl_Gun nextGun, int[] info, int newSlotID)
	{
		Animator headAnimator = this.HeadAnimator;
		if (headAnimator != null)
		{
			headAnimator.Play("TakeGun", 0, 0f);

		if (currentGun != null)
		{
			currentGun.DisableWeapon(false);
		}

			bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
			if (instance != null)
			{
				instance.SetEquippedSlot(newSlotID);

		}
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(this.PickUpTime);
		this.AllGuns.ForEach(delegate(bl_Gun x)
		{
			if (x != null)
			{
				x.gameObject.SetActive(false);
			}
		});
		this.TakeWeapon(nextGun, true);
		if (currentGun != null)
		{
			bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.Instance.ThrowGun(new bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.ThrowData
			{
				GunID = currentGun.GunID,
				Origin = this.GetThrowPosition(),
				Direction = this.GetThrowDirection(),
				Data = info,
				AutoDestroy = false
			});
		}
		bl_EventHandler.ChangeWeaponEvent(nextGun.GunID);

	private void AddWeaponToSlot(int slot, bl_Gun weapon, bool addSlotIfNotExist = false)
	{
		if (this.PlayerEquip == null)
		{
			this.PlayerEquip = new List<bl_Gun>();
		}
		if (this.PlayerEquip.Count - 1 < slot)
		{
			if (!addSlotIfNotExist)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning(string.Format("Weapon slot {0} has not been preassigned.", slot));
				return;
			}
			while (this.PlayerEquip.Count - 1 < slot)
			{
				this.PlayerEquip.Add(null);
			}
		}
		this.PlayerEquip[slot] = weapon;
	}

	// Token: 0x060009FB RID: 2555 RVA: 0x0002C370 File Offset: 0x0002A570
	public void OnDisconnected(DisconnectCause cause)
	{
		if (cause == DisconnectCause.DisconnectByClientLogic)
		{
			if (this.quittingApp)
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from Server!");
				return;
			}
			if (this.ServerRegionID == -1 && this.connectionState != LobbyConnectionState.Authenticating && PhotonNetwork.PhotonServerSettings.AppSettings.UseNameServer)
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from cloud!");
			}
			else if (this.connectionState == LobbyConnectionState.ChangingRegion)
			{
				Debug.Log(string.Format("Changing server! region to: {0}", this.ServerRegionID));
				this.ConnectToServerRegion(this.ServerRegionID, false);
				bl_LobbyRoomListBase instance = bl_LobbyRoomListBase.Instance;
				if (instance == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				instance.ClearList();
				return;
			}
			else if (this.connectionState == LobbyConnectionState.Authenticating)
			{
				Debug.Log("Authentication complete, finishing connection...");
				bl_LobbyLoadingScreenBase.Instance.SetText("FINISHING UP...".Localized(198, false));
				if (!PhotonNetwork.PhotonServerSettings.AppSettings.UseNameServer)
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					return;
				}
				PhotonNetwork.AuthValues = new AuthenticationValues(bl_PhotonNetwork.NickName);
				if (this.ServerRegionID == -1)
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					return;
				}
				this.ConnectToServerRegion(this.ServerRegionID, false);
				return;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from Server.");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			bl_LobbyUI.Instance.blackScreenFader.FadeOut(1f, null);
			bl_LobbyUI.Instance.connectionPopupMessage.SetConfirmationText("Try again".ToUpper());
			if (cause != DisconnectCause.CustomAuthenticationFailed)
			{
				bl_LobbyUI.Instance.connectionPopupMessage.AskConfirmation(string.Format(bl_GameTexts.DisconnectCause.Localized(41, false), cause.ToString()), delegate
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					Debug.LogWarning("Failed to connect to server, cause: " + cause.ToString());
				}, null);
			}
		}
		this.connectionState = LobbyConnectionState.Disconnected;
	}

		select x.ShowName).ToArray<string>(), true);

	// Token: 0x06000D07 RID: 3335 RVA: 0x00038A30 File Offset: 0x00036C30
	private void SetupGameModeDependentsSelectors()
	{
		this.allModes = this.GetModesForCurrentMap();
		GameModeSettings gameModeSettings = this.allModes[this.GameMode];
		bool flag = gameModeSettings.gameMode == global::GameMode.SURVIVAL;
		bool flag2 = gameModeSettings.gameMode == global::GameMode.GRENADE_DUEL;
		bool flag3 = flag;
		bool flag4 = flag || flag2;
		this.MaxPlayersSelector.SetOptions(gameModeSettings.maxPlayers.AsStringArray(" " + this.endPoints[0]), true);
		this.TimeLimitSelector.SetOptions((from x in gameModeSettings.timeLimits
		select string.Format("{0} {1}", x / 60, this.endPoints[1])).ToArray<string>(), true);
		if (gameModeSettings.GameGoalsOptions.Length != 0)
		{
			this.GameGoalSelector.SetOptions(gameModeSettings.GameGoalsOptions.AsStringArray(" " + gameModeSettings.GoalName), true);
		}
		else
		{
			this.GameGoalSelector.SetOptions(new string[]
			{
				gameModeSettings.GoalName
			}, true);
		}
		if (flag3)
		{
			this.BotsActiveSelector.currentOption = 1;
			this.BotsActiveSelector.ApplyCurrentValue(false);
			this.BotsActiveSelector.gameObject.SetActive(false);
		}
		else
		{
			this.BotsActiveSelector.gameObject.SetActive(gameModeSettings.supportBots);
			if (gameModeSettings.supportBots && this.BotsActiveSelector.currentOption == 0)
			{
				this.BotsActiveSelector.currentOption = 1;
				this.BotsActiveSelector.ApplyCurrentValue(false);
			}
		}
		if (flag4)
		{
			this.FriendlyFireSelector.currentOption = 0;
			this.FriendlyFireSelector.ApplyCurrentValue(false);
			this.FriendlyFireSelector.gameObject.SetActive(false);
		}
		else
		{
			this.FriendlyFireSelector.gameObject.SetActive(true);
		}
		this.TeamSelectionSelector.SetActive(!gameModeSettings.AutoTeamSelection && !flag);
		this.PerRoundSelector.SetActive(gameModeSettings.RoundModeAllowed == GameModeSettings.RoundModeAllowedOptions.AllowBoth);
	}

	private IEnumerator DoChangeWindow(bl_LobbyUI.WindowUI window)

			{

	}

	// Token: 0x06000D40 RID: 3392 RVA: 0x00039BA8 File Offset: 0x00037DA8
	public void LoadSettings()
	{
		this.ApplyRuntimeSettings();
		if (PlayerPrefs.GetInt("Kick", 0) == 1)
		{
			this.ShowPopUpWindow("kicked");
		}
		if (bl_PhotonNetwork.Instance.hasPingKick)
		{
			this.ShowPopUpWindow("ping kick");
			bl_PhotonNetwork.Instance.hasPingKick = false;
		}
		PlayerPrefs.SetInt("Kick", 0);
		bl_Lobby.Instance.rememberMe = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PlayerPrefs.GetString(PropertiesKeys.GetUniqueKey("remembernick"), string.Empty));
		if (bl_PhotonNetwork.Instance.hasAFKKick)
		{
			this.ShowPopUpWindow("afk kick");
			bl_PhotonNetwork.Instance.hasAFKKick = false;
		}
		bl_Input.Initialize();
		bl_Input.CheckGamePadRequired();
		bl_LevelManager.Instance.Initialize();
		if (bl_LevelManager.Instance.isNewLevel)
		{
			LevelInfo level = bl_LevelManager.Instance.GetLevel();
			this.m_LevelUI.Icon.sprite = level.Icon;
			this.m_LevelUI.LevelNameText.text = level.Name;
			this.m_LevelUI.Root.SetActive(true);
			bl_LevelManager.Instance.Refresh();
		}
		bl_LevelManager.Instance.GetInfo();
		if (bl_GameData.Instance.MasterCanKickPlayers)
		{
			PhotonNetwork.EnableCloseConnection = true;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000D41 RID: 3393 RVA: 0x00039CDC File Offset: 0x00037EDC
	private void ApplyRuntimeSettings()
	{
		if (bl_MFPS.Settings != null)
		{
			bl_RuntimeSettingsProfile.ResolutionApplication resolutionApplication = (bl_ResolutionSettings.ResolutionHandler == null) ? bl_RuntimeSettingsProfile.ResolutionApplication.ApplyCurrent : bl_RuntimeSettingsProfile.ResolutionApplication.NoApply;
			bl_MFPS.Settings.ApplySettings(resolutionApplication, false);
			Application.targetFrameRate = bl_MFPS.Settings.RefreshRates[(int)bl_MFPS.Settings.GetSettingOf("Frame Rate")];
			bl_MFPS.MusicVolume = (float)bl_MFPS.Settings.GetSettingOf("Music Volume");
			bl_AudioController.Instance.ForceStopAllFades();
			bl_AudioController.Instance.BackgroundVolume = bl_MFPS.MusicVolume;
			bl_AudioController.Instance.MaxBackgroundVolume = bl_MFPS.MusicVolume;

				break;

		}

		this.ServersDropdown.onValueChanged.AddListener(new UnityAction<int>(this.ChangeServerCloud));
	}

	// Token: 0x060004DA RID: 1242 RVA: 0x00017018 File Offset: 0x00015218
	private bool ParseLoginData(string result)
	{
		string[] array = result.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.None);
		if (!array[0].Contains("success"))
		{
			return false;
		}
		this.loginUserData = new Dictionary<string, string>();
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[i]) && i != 0)
			{
				string[] array2 = array[i].Split('|', StringSplitOptions.None);
				this.loginUserData.Add(array2[0], array2[1]);
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private string GetSteamSuffix(string steamId, int retryCount)

	private void Refresh()

		{
			this.selectedNewsId = -1;

			this.detailDate.text = string.Empty;
			this.detailBody.text = "there are not news yet";

			this.UpdateCommentsUI(null);
			this.UpdateInteractionState();
			return;

		{
			this.SelectNews(this.selectedNewsId);
		}

		{
			this.SelectNews(this.listItems[0].NewsId);
		}

	// Token: 0x060010A7 RID: 4263 RVA: 0x0004BAAC File Offset: 0x00049CAC
	private void BuildNewsList()
	{
		this.newsById.Clear();
		List<bl_NewsData.NewsItem> list = new List<bl_NewsData.NewsItem>(bl_NewsData.Items);
		list.Sort((bl_NewsData.NewsItem a, bl_NewsData.NewsItem b) => this.CompareDates(b.date, a.date));
		foreach (bl_NewsUI.NewsListItemUI newsListItemUI in this.listItems)
		{
			if (newsListItemUI.Root != null)
			{
				Object.Destroy(newsListItemUI.Root);
			}
		}
		this.listItems.Clear();
		this.newsById.Clear();
		for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			bl_NewsData.NewsItem newsItem = list[i];
			this.newsById[newsItem.id] = newsItem;
			bl_NewsUI.NewsListItemUI item = this.CreateNewsListItem(newsItem);
			this.listItems.Add(item);
		}
		LayoutRebuilder.ForceRebuildLayoutImmediate(this.listContent);
	}

	// Token: 0x060010B3 RID: 4275 RVA: 0x0004C5FC File Offset: 0x0004A7FC
	private void RequestNewsStats()
	{
		if (bl_LoginProDataBase.Instance == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.webRequest == null)
		{
			this.webRequest = new bl_ULoginWebRequest(this);
		}
		if (this.newsById.Count == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		string value = string.Join<int>(",", this.newsById.Keys);
		WWWForm wwwform = bl_DataBaseUtils.CreateWWWForm(false, true);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("typ", 1);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("news_ids", value);
		if (this.IsLoggedIn)
		{
			wwwform.AddSecureField("id", bl_DataBase.Instance.LocalUser.ID);
		}
		this.webRequest.POST(this.GetNewsUrl(), wwwform, delegate(ULoginResult result)
		{
			if (result.resultState != ULoginResult.Status.Success)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Text))
			{
				return;
			}
			bl_NewsUI.NewsStatsList newsStatsList = JsonUtility.FromJson<bl_NewsUI.NewsStatsList>("{\"items\":" + result.Text + "}");
			if (newsStatsList == null || newsStatsList.items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.statsById.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < newsStatsList.items.Length; i++)
			{
				bl_NewsUI.NewsStats newsStats = newsStatsList.items[i];
				this.statsById[newsStats.newsId] = newsStats;
			}
			this.UpdateStatsUI(this.selectedNewsId);
		}, null);
	}

	// Token: 0x060010B4 RID: 4276 RVA: 0x0004C6B0 File Offset: 0x0004A8B0
	private void RequestComments(int newsId)
	{
		if (bl_LoginProDataBase.Instance == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.webRequest == null)
		{
			this.webRequest = new bl_ULoginWebRequest(this);
		}
		if (newsId <= 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		WWWForm wwwform = bl_DataBaseUtils.CreateWWWForm(false, true);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("typ", 2);
		wwwform.AddSecureField("news_id", newsId);
		if (this.IsLoggedIn)
		{
			wwwform.AddSecureField("id", bl_DataBase.Instance.LocalUser.ID);
		}
		this.webRequest.POST(this.GetNewsUrl(), wwwform, delegate(ULoginResult result)
		{
			if (result.resultState != ULoginResult.Status.Success)
			{
				this.UpdateCommentsUI(null);
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Text))
			{
				this.UpdateCommentsUI(null);
				return;
			}
			bl_NewsUI.NewsCommentList newsCommentList = JsonUtility.FromJson<bl_NewsUI.NewsCommentList>("{\"items\":" + result.Text + "}");
			if (newsCommentList == null || newsCommentList.items == null)
			{
				this.UpdateCommentsUI(null);
				return;
			}
			List<bl_NewsUI.NewsComment> comments = new List<bl_NewsUI.NewsComment>(newsCommentList.items);
			this.UpdateCommentsUI(comments);
		}, null);
	}

	// Token: 0x060010B9 RID: 4281 RVA: 0x0004C948 File Offset: 0x0004AB48
	private int CompareDates(string a, string b)
	{
		DateTime dateTime;
		DateTime value;
		if (DateTime.TryParseExact(a, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out dateTime) && DateTime.TryParseExact(b, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out value))
		{
			return dateTime.CompareTo(value);
		}
		return string.Compare(a, b, StringComparison.Ordinal);
	}

	// Token: 0x060010BA RID: 4282 RVA: 0x0004C990 File Offset: 0x0004AB90
	private string FormatDateTime(string raw)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw))
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
		DateTime dateTime;
		if (DateTime.TryParse(raw, this.usCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out dateTime))
		{
			return dateTime.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy", this.usCulture);
		}
		return raw;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000A9B RID: 2715 RVA: 0x0002E314 File Offset: 0x0002C514
	[PunRPC]
	private void FireSync(GunType weaponType, Vector3 hitPosition, Vector3 inaccuracity)
	{
		if (this.CurrenGun == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		switch (weaponType)
		{
		case GunType.Shotgun:
		case GunType.Sniper:
		case GunType.Burst:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			return;
		case GunType.Machinegun:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Machinegun);
			return;
		case GunType.Pistol:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Pistol);
			return;
		case GunType.Knife:
			this.CurrenGun.KnifeFire();
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Knife);
			return;
		}
		Debug.LogWarning("Not defined weapon type to sync bullets.");
	}

		item.StatusText.gameObject.SetActive(flag);
		item.Background.color = (flag ? new Color(0.12f, 0.2f, 0.12f, 0.95f) : new Color(0.14f, 0.14f, 0.14f, 0.95f));
		item.ProgressFill.color = new Color(0.98f, 0.82f, 0.15f, 0.95f);

	// Token: 0x06001216 RID: 4630 RVA: 0x000581CC File Offset: 0x000563CC
	private void EvaluateQuestList(List<bl_QuestsUI.QuestDefinition> list)
	{
		if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			bl_QuestsUI.QuestDefinition questDefinition = list[i];
			if (this.GetProgressValue(questDefinition) >= questDefinition.Target && !this.IsQuestDone(questDefinition))
			{
				this.GrantReward(questDefinition);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001217 RID: 4631 RVA: 0x00058220 File Offset: 0x00056420
	private void GrantReward(bl_QuestsUI.QuestDefinition quest)
	{
		MFPSCoin coin = bl_MFPS.Coins.GetCoinData(quest.RewardCoinId);
		if (coin == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (!bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.SetQuestDone(quest);
		string arg = (quest.Category == bl_QuestsUI.QuestCategory.Daily) ? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.currentDailyCycle) ? this.GetDailyCycleStamp() : this.currentDailyCycle) : ((quest.Category == bl_QuestsUI.QuestCategory.Weekly) ? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.currentWeeklyCycle) ? this.GetWeeklyCycleStamp() : this.currentWeeklyCycle) : "all");
		string.Format("{0}.{1}.{2}", quest.Category, arg, quest.Id);
		bl_DataBase.Instance.ClaimReward("quest", quest.Id, delegate(bool granted)
		{
			if (!granted)
			{
				this.ClearQuestDone(quest);
				return;
			}
			bl_EventHandler.DispatchCoinUpdate(coin);
		}, -1, -1, -2, null, null, null);
	}

	private int GetProgressValueForBase(bl_QuestsUI.QuestType type, int baseKills, int baseMatches, int baseWins, int baseDamage)
	{

		{
		case bl_QuestsUI.QuestType.MatchesPlayed:
			return this.totalMatches - baseMatches;
		case bl_QuestsUI.QuestType.Wins:
			return this.totalWins - baseWins;
		case bl_QuestsUI.QuestType.Damage:
			return this.totalDamage - baseDamage;
		default:
			return this.totalKills - baseKills;
		}
	}

	private bl_QuestsUI.QuestSummary[] BuildSummaries(List<bl_QuestsUI.QuestDefinition> quests, int maxItems)
	{

		{
			return Array.Empty<bl_QuestsUI.QuestSummary>();
		}
		int num = Mathf.Min(maxItems, quests.Count);
		bl_QuestsUI.QuestSummary[] array = new bl_QuestsUI.QuestSummary[num];
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			bl_QuestsUI.QuestDefinition questDefinition = quests[i];
			array[i] = new bl_QuestsUI.QuestSummary
			{
				Title = questDefinition.Title,
				Progress = Mathf.Clamp(this.GetProgressValue(questDefinition), 0, questDefinition.Target),
				Target = questDefinition.Target,
				Reward = questDefinition.Reward,
				RewardCoinId = questDefinition.RewardCoinId,
				RewardLabel = questDefinition.RewardLabel,
				Completed = this.IsQuestDone(questDefinition)
			};
		}
		return array;
	}

		{

			num,

			quest.Reward,

	private void OnClaimClicked()

		{

			{
				if (granted)
				{
					bl_EventHandler.DispatchCoinUpdate(bl_MFPS.Coins.GetCoinData((paidCoin >= 0) ? paidCoin : reward.CoinId) ?? coin);
					bl_LobbyUI.ShowOverAllMessage(string.Format("DAILY REWARD CLAIMED: +{0}", (paidAmount > 0) ? paidAmount : reward.Amount));
				}
				else
				{
					bl_LobbyUI.ShowOverAllMessage("DAILY REWARD ALREADY CLAIMED TODAY.");
				}
				this.UpdateUi(true);
			}, -1, -1, -2, null, null, delegate(int c, int a)
			{
				paidCoin = c;
				paidAmount = a;
			});
		}
		long utcNowSeconds = bl_RewardsUI.GetUtcNowSeconds();
		this.nextClaimUtcSeconds = utcNowSeconds + (long)bl_RewardsUI.DailyCooldown.TotalSeconds;
		this.lastRewardIndex = num;
		this.SaveState();
		string text2 = string.Format("DAILY REWARD CLAIMED: +{0} {1}", reward.Amount, reward.Label);
		this.claimedToastText.text = text2;
		this.UpdateUi(true);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600123E RID: 4670 RVA: 0x00059950 File Offset: 0x00057B50
	private int PickRewardIndex()
	{
		if (bl_RewardsUI.RewardOptions.Length <= 1)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		int num = Random.Range(0, bl_RewardsUI.RewardOptions.Length);
		if (num == this.lastRewardIndex)
		{
			num = (num + Random.Range(1, bl_RewardsUI.RewardOptions.Length)) % bl_RewardsUI.RewardOptions.Length;
		}
		return num;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600123F RID: 4671 RVA: 0x00059999 File Offset: 0x00057B99
	private bool CanClaimNow(out string reason)

		}
		return bl_RewardsUI.GetUtcNowSeconds() >= this.nextClaimUtcSeconds;
	}

			this.nextText.text = "You can claim now.";

			this.statusText.color = bl_RewardsUI.WhiteText;

			this.claimButton.interactable = false;
			this.claimButtonImage.color = new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.9f);

	public static void SaveLocalPlayerKDS(Action<bool> callback = null, int overrideScore = -1, int overrideKills = -1)
	{
		if (!bl_DataBase.IsUserLogged)
		{
			Debug.Log("Player has to be logged in order to save data");
			return;
		}
		Player localPlayer = bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer;
		LoginUserInfo localUser = bl_DataBase.Instance.LocalUser;
		int score = (overrideScore == -1) ? localPlayer.GetPlayerScore() : overrideScore;
		int kills = (overrideKills == -1) ? localPlayer.GetKills() : overrideKills;
		if (!localUser.SendNewData(kills, localPlayer.GetDeaths(), score))
		{
			return;
		}
		ULoginUpdateFields uloginUpdateFields = new ULoginUpdateFields();
		uloginUpdateFields.AddField("kills", localUser.Kills);
		uloginUpdateFields.AddField("deaths", localUser.Deaths);
		uloginUpdateFields.AddField("score", localUser.Score);
		bl_DataBase.Instance.UpdateUserData(uloginUpdateFields, callback);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000521 RID: 1313 RVA: 0x000186C3 File Offset: 0x000168C3

	// Token: 0x06000522 RID: 1314 RVA: 0x000186D8 File Offset: 0x000168D8
	public static bool SendNewData(this LoginUserInfo userInfo, int kills, int deaths, int score)
	{
		if (kills == 0 && deaths == 0 && score == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}
		int num = Mathf.Max(1, score);
		userInfo.Score += num;
		userInfo.Kills += kills;
		userInfo.Deaths += deaths;
		return true;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000523 RID: 1315 RVA: 0x00018724 File Offset: 0x00016924
	public static string GetLocalUserInitialCoins()
	{
		string text = "";
		List<MFPSCoin> allCoins = bl_MFPS.Coins.GetAllCoins();
		for (int i = 0; i < allCoins.Count; i++)
		{
			MFPSCoin mfpscoin = allCoins[i];
			text += string.Format("{0}", mfpscoin.InitialCoins);
			if (i != allCoins.Count - 1)
			{
				text += "&";
			}
		}
		return text;
	}
}

// Token: 0x0200002E RID: 46
public class bl_UnityIAPShopHandler
{
	// Token: 0x060003D7 RID: 983 RVA: 0x000116E0 File Offset: 0x0000F8E0
	public void OnPurchaseResult(string productID, string receip)
	{
		bl_ShopData.ShopVirtualCoins coinPack = bl_ShopData.Instance.CoinsPacks.Find((bl_ShopData.ShopVirtualCoins x) => x.ID == productID);
		if (coinPack != null)
		{
			CoinPurchaseData coinPurchaseData = new CoinPurchaseData();
			coinPurchaseData.coins = coinPack.GetCoins();
			coinPurchaseData.productID = productID;
			coinPurchaseData.receipt = receip;
			coinPurchaseData.coinID = bl_ShopData.Instance.CoinToApplyPurchases;
			bl_DataBase.Instance.SetCoinPurchase(coinPurchaseData, delegate(bool success)
			{
				if (success)
				{
					bl_UnityIAP.Instance.ConfirmPendingPurchase();
					bl_EventHandler.DispatchCoinUpdate(null);
					bl_ShopNotification instance = bl_ShopNotification.Instance;
					if (instance != null)
					{
						instance.Show(string.Format("<b><size=20>PURCHASE COMPLETE</size></b>\n{0} COINS HAS BEEN ADDED TO YOUR ACCOUNT.", coinPack.GetCoins())).Hide(3f);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Debug.LogError("Couldn't save purchase in DataBase!");
				}
				bl_LobbyUI.Instance.overAllEmptyLoading.SetActive(false);
			});
			return;
		}
		Debug.LogErrorFormat("Can't find product purchase '{0}'", new object[]
		{
			productID
		});
	}
}

	public override void InstancePlayerList()

			else if (playerList[i].GetPlayerTeam() == Team.Team1)
			{
				this.SetPlayerToList(playerList[i]);
			}
			else if (playerList[i].GetPlayerTeam() == Team.Team2)
			{
				list.Add(playerList[i]);
			}
		}
		if (!otm)
		{
			this.PlayerListHeaders[1].SetAsLastSibling();

	public override void UpdatePlayerCount()
	{

		if (requiredPlayersToStart > 1)
		{
			bool flag = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length >= requiredPlayersToStart;
			this.readyButtons[0].interactable = (bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient && PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length >= requiredPlayersToStart);
			this.PlayerCountText.text = string.Format("{0} OF {2} PLAYERS ({1} MAX)", PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length, PhotonNetwork.CurrentRoom.MaxPlayers, requiredPlayersToStart);

			if (gameObject != null)
			{
				gameObject.SetActive(!flag);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			this.readyButtons[0].interactable = true;
			GameObject gameObject2 = this.waitingRequiredPlayersUI;
			if (gameObject2 != null)
			{
				gameObject2.SetActive(false);
			}
			this.PlayerCountText.text = string.Format("{0} PLAYERS ({1} MAX)", PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length, PhotonNetwork.CurrentRoom.MaxPlayers);
		}
		int spectatorsCount = this.GetSpectatorsCount();
		if (spectatorsCount > 0)
		{

			playerCountText.text += string.Format(" SPECTATORS {0}", spectatorsCount);

	}

	// Token: 0x060010CC RID: 4300 RVA: 0x0004CF10 File Offset: 0x0004B110
	private static string NormalizeForCompare(string value)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
		foreach (char c in value)
		{
			if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
			}
		}
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}

	private Color ColorForSurface(Collider c)
	{
		if (c != null)
		{
			string text = c.gameObject.name.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (text.Contains("grass") || text.Contains("foliage") || text.Contains("flower"))
			{
				return new Color(0.62f, 0.63f, 0.44f, 0.7f);
			}
			if (text.Contains("wood") || text.Contains("crate") || text.Contains("plank"))
			{
				return new Color(0.76f, 0.58f, 0.36f, 0.85f);
			}
			if (text.Contains("metal") || text.Contains("steel") || text.Contains("car") || text.Contains("vehicle"))
			{
				return new Color(0.86f, 0.88f, 0.92f, 0.85f);
			}
		}
		Color result = Color.Lerp(RenderSettings.fogColor, Color.white, 0.25f);
		result.a = 0.8f;
		return result;
	}
